# rdf

**Tag**: data

## 简介

RDF.rb is a pure-Ruby library for working with Resource Description Framework (RDF) data.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/ruby-rdf/rdf
- 文档: https://ruby-rdf.github.io/rdf
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/ruby-rdf/rdf/issues
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/rdf
